description: When imuxsock plain trusted-property annotation is enabled, a local process can inject additional fields into the appended trusted-property block through its process name or executable path.
Out-of-bounds read crashes rsyslogd when a template formats a crafted low-year timestamp as a weekday name
libXfont2 prior to version 2.0.10 contains an uninitialized variable vulnerability (CWE-457) in its FreeType backend that leads to an out-of-bounds read (CWE-125).
rsyslog option.json templates can emit malformed JSON for quote-only or backslash-only field values

When imuxsock uses the system timestamp and its special parser, an accepted short timestamp can leave the TAG parser with a cursor and remaining length that describe different parts of the received message.
An out-of-bounds write flaw was found in virglrenderer, the host-side 3D renderer used by virtual machines with virtio-gpu OpenGL acceleration enabled.
Bound imuxsock PRI digit accumulation to the three digits accepted by its syntax check.
imdtls can stall its listener and bypass permitted-peer checks during DTLS sessions
imdtls can stall its listener and bypass permitted-peer checks during DTLS sessions

When imuxsock is configured with UsePIDFromSystem="on" or SysSock.UsePIDFromSystem="on", its special parser rewrites the message TAG with the kernel-supplied process ID through fixPID(). For a message with an empty TAG, the parsed TAG length is zero. fixPID() then computes an offset of -1 and copies the "[<pid>]:" suffix starting one byte before the stack-allocated TAG buffer.
imdtls can stall its listener and bypass permitted-peer checks during DTLS sessions
A flaw was found in virglrenderer, the virtual OpenGL renderer used to provide 3D graphics acceleration to virtual machines.
mmanon stack buffer overflow while anonymizing embedded IPv4-in-IPv6 text
needrestart does not properly validate process names and cgroup paths, allowing a local attacker to escalate privileges to root or inject arbitrary output.
Mustache for Ruby: RCE using built-in method access
Filament Curator: Cross-tenant media metadata disclosure via Curator picker search
flac: flac: symlink-following file overwrite in metadata edits
icecast: icecast: use-after-free read in mp3_set_title() via stale inline_url pointer

tnef: tnef: Unbounded memory allocation and reachable assert via crafted MAPI property value count
Drupal core ships with an `install.php` file for installing Drupal core.
Drupal core contains a chain of methods that could be exploitable when an insecure deserialization vulnerability exists on the site.
The InfoScan Electron desktop client improperly handles TLS certificate errors by accepting certificates without validating their trustworthiness.

The publicly distributed InfoScan Electron installer contains configuration files identifying hostnames associated with customer installations and internal development, testing, and database infrastructure.
InfoScan uses hard-coded cryptographic keys and initialization-vector values in its database-encryption implementation.
InfoScan does not enforce authentication on an endpoint used to retrieve sales-automation templates.
InfoScan contains an unauthenticated information disclosure vulnerability in its mobile-enumeration and version-reporting endpoints.
InfoScan fails to properly handle certain malformed or incomplete requests to its login and password-reset endpoints.
